change: Resolve root interactive manifests at the native admission boundary, reuse the successful configuration, and carry failed resolutions into the existing native refusal path without a second read. Apply explicit simple-profile deadlines from boundary entry, before lookup, and preserve shorter limits. Other modes retain their existing policy.

initial_diagnostics.finding: Lint removed the externally used runner resolver export; restored its explicit re-export.

A new assertion compared an inside-boundary timestamp to an earlier caller timestamp without call-entry tolerance. Corrected the tolerance; the separate forty-second lookup-time accounting assertion remains exact.

checks: Ruff lint/format and diff checks pass; size caps unchanged. New profile, action-policy and admission-audit tests are included in runtime-contract CI; no hosted run is claimed.
audit_evidence: The native entrypoint resolves a simple profile with no supplied agent_config, then stalls acceptance under a shortened test deadline. Execution is never called; the real tracking DAL preserves a timeout recoverable by original request identity. Actual native execution also verifies one manifest lookup and the deadline present before its synthetic model call.
limits: Only explicit simple manifest declarations establish this new policy. No heuristic classification of arbitrary conversation is claimed. The local manifest lookup remains synchronous; elapsed lookup time is charged when it returns, but this change does not interrupt a blocked filesystem read. HTTP transport/provider fixtures are synthetic; no deployment-ingress or live-provider performance certification. Full product acceptance and manual repeated-confirmation review remain open. No production changes.
